(2) Any person attaining the age of 21 years on the
date fixed for scrutiny, if not otherwise disqualified under
the provisions of the Act or any order made thereunder, may
be nominated as a candidate for election from any seat of a
constituency to a Gram Panchayat, from any constituency to
a Panchayat Samiti or Zilla Parishad or Mahakuma Parishad
as the case may be, if his name is included in the electoral
roll in force on the last date for making nominations for such
Panchayat election when such electoral roll pertains to the
area comprised in that Gram in case of Gram Panchayat or
pertains to the area of the Panchayat Samiti or Zilla Parishad
or Mahakuma Parishad in case of Panchayat Samiti, Zilla
Parishad or Mahakuma Parishad as the case may be.
(3) Every nomination paper shall be subscribed by a
proposer in the manner as shown in Form 2.
(4) Any person whose name is included in the list
of voters of the constituency for which the candidate is
nominated and who himself is not contesting the election
from that constituency, may subscribe as proposer:
Provided that a person shall not subscribe as proposer,
more than one nomination:
Provided further that where in a constituency more than
one seats are required to be filled, a person may subscribe the
nomination paper relating to each seat.
